Plan first, create the files, run the app, fix errors.2Build the weekend MVP of "CabinetSafe": a person lists every prescription, supplement and over-the-counter medicine once, and the app re-checks the whole list against documented interaction records every time something changes. It reports what the records say. It gives no medical advice.34Stack: Next.js (App Router), TypeScript, Tailwind, Supabase (Postgres, Row Level Security, Auth with email magic link), the RxNorm API from the US National Library of Medicine to identify drug names. The interaction records are a table you load from published sources, each with a source name and a link. No model writes any medical text. Deploy on Vercel.56Tables (Row Level Security on, a user reads only their own profiles; interaction_records is read-only to signed-in users):7- profiles(id, owner_user_id, display_name, birth_year)8- medications(id, profile_id, rxcui, display_name, raw_input, dose, kind, prescriber, added_at, stopped_at) kind is prescription, otc or supplement9- interaction_records(id, rxcui_a, rxcui_b, severity, source_name, source_url, record_text) severity is major, moderate or minor10- screens(id, profile_id, run_at, medication_ids uuid[], flag_count)11- flags(id, screen_id, rxcui_a, rxcui_b, severity, source_name, source_url, record_text)1213Screens: /login, /cabinet/[profileId] (the list and the flags), /summary/[screenId] (one printable page).Prompt 1 is free. A free account unlocks the other prompts and the full research.Unlock the full research for Multi-Doctor Medication Interaction CheckerRESEARCHED · WEEKEND-SIZED ·

A note fromJohnI started Weekend MVP to close the gap between “I have an idea” and “here’s a live URL.” Most people with a day job don’t lack ideas or talent. They lack a small enough place to start.So every idea here is researched, sized for a weekend, and paired with prompts for the AI tools you already use. Pick one. Build it on Saturday. Show someone on Sunday.John IseghohiFounder, Weekend MVP · runs a community of 400+ weekend buildersMore about John

Pick an idea.Build it this weekend.Browse 229 ideasGet the free Starter KitDo I need to code?No. Every Weekend MVP idea ships with copy-paste prompts for AI builders like Cursor, Claude, Bolt, and Lovable. You pick an idea, paste the prompts, and follow a three-screen MVP (landing → input → output). Coding helps, but it’s not required to get a demo live by Sunday.Do I have to quit my job?No. Most ideas are scoped to about 8–12 hours — roughly one weekend around a 9-to-5. The site is built for solo founders and side builders who want a live URL and early users, not a sabbatical or a co-founder.Are the ideas free?Yes. Browsing the idea library is free. Some full research pages ask for an email to unlock deeper prompts and sources. The Weekend MVP Starter Kit (scorecard, 48-hour plan, templates) is also free.How do I build an MVP in a weekend?Pick an idea small enough for 8–12 hours, cut it to three screens (landing, input, output), and paste the prompts into an AI builder like Cursor, Claude, Bolt, or Lovable. Build on Saturday, deploy, and put the live link in front of real users on Sunday. The free Starter Kit includes a 48-hour plan.
